sql_executes: SELECT d.annee, COUNT(*) AS nb_ventes FROM gold.fct_transferts AS t JOIN gold.dim_energie AS e ON t.code_energie = e.code_energie JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON t.date_transaction = d.date_jour WHERE e.famille_energie = 'Hybride' GROUP BY d.annee ORDER BY d.annee LIMIT 1000
details.sql_attendu: SELECT year(date_transaction) a, count(*) FROM fct_transferts t JOIN dim_energie e ON e.code_energie = t.code_energie WHERE e.famille_energie = 'Hybride' GROUP BY 1

details.question: Quelle est la puissance fiscale moyenne des véhicules vendus d'occasion en 2025, arrondie à une décimale ?
sql_executes: SELECT ROUND(AVG(puissance_administrative_cv), 1) AS puissance_fiscale_moyenne FROM gold.fct_transferts WHERE YEAR(date_transaction) = 2025 AND NOT puissance_administrative_cv IS NULL LIMIT 1000
details.sql_attendu: SELECT round(avg(puissance_administrative_cv), 1) FROM fct_transferts WHERE year(date_transaction) = 2025

details.question: Combien de ventes de véhicules d'occasion ont eu lieu en 2025 pour des véhicules mis en circulation avant 2010 ?
sql_executes: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_ventes FROM gold.fct_transferts WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_transaction) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_premiere_circulation) < 2010 LIMIT 1000
details.sql_attendu: SELECT count(*) FROM fct_transferts WHERE year(date_transaction) = 2025 AND date_premiere_circulation < DATE '2010-01-01'

details.question: Combien de ventes de véhicules d'occasion ont eu lieu en décembre 2024 ?
sql_executes: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_ventes FROM gold.fct_transferts WHERE date_transaction >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND date_transaction <= CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
details.sql_attendu: SELECT count(*) FROM fct_transferts WHERE date_transaction BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
